updates.detailed_summary_zh: 据CoinDesk 2026年8月20日报道，埃隆·马斯克旗下的X平台正在探索使用稳定币向网红和内容提供者付款。该计划仍处于探索阶段，尚未确认具体使用哪种稳定币或推出时间表。 如果实现，这可能在世界上最大的社交平台之一上为稳定币提供一个极具可见度的现实支付应用场景。这也表明，主流互联网公司正越来越多地将基于加密的支付视为创作者变现的可行基础设施。 报道强调，这一探索仍处于初步阶段，X尚未公开宣布与任何稳定币发行方合作。此举将建立在马斯克长期以来对将支付功能整合进X的兴趣之上，X已在美国多个州获得货币转账牌照。
updates.detailed_summary_en: According to a CoinDesk report dated August 20, 2026, Elon Musk's X platform is exploring the use of stablecoins to pay influencers and content providers. The effort is still in an exploratory phase and no specific stablecoin or rollout timeline has been confirmed. If realized, this could give stablecoins a massively visible real-world payments use case on one of the world's largest social platforms. It also signals that mainstream internet companies are increasingly treating crypto-based payments as a viable infrastructure for creator monetization. The report emphasizes that the exploration is preliminary and that X has not publicly announced any partnership with a stablecoin issuer. The move would build on Musk's long-standing interest in integrating payments into X, which has already obtained money-transmitter licenses in several U.S. states.
